title: Astigmatism
definition: A common and generally treatable imperfection in the eye's curvature that causes blurred, distorted, or doubled vision at all distances due to uneven focusing of light rays.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested under General Science (Physics in Biology context / Human Eye optics) in UPSC Prelims, and relevant for public health policies in Mains GS-2 (Health infrastructure).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and optical mechanisms of Astigmatism.
Evaluate clinical classifications, diagnostic methods, and corrective measures.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Anatomy of the human eye (cornea, lens, retina)
